title: Blinded per-patient validation of GAPE A-score on individual pre-diagnostic breast cancer methylation arrays
h_min_source: G-003b MCMC posterior (800,000 samples per substrate, R-hat < 1.001)
rationale: The Evidence Report describes VAL-047 as a validation of individual-patient A-score scoring on blood methylation arrays, but no archived JSON result file exists for it. Re-run from scratch with blinded pre-registered design to produce an audit-trail-complete result.

design.type: Blinded retrospective per-patient validation with pre-specified decision rules

cohort.cancer_cases_by_icd10: To be determined at phase 2 unblinding (expected: ~146 C50 breast cancer, small numbers of C73/C18/C19/C80, remainder controls)

blinding_protocol.phase_1: Extract only beta values at pre-specified CpGs plus age. Script REFUSES to parse cancer-type or time-to-diagnosis columns. Computes A-scores and produces ranked output.
blinding_protocol.freezing: SHA-256 hash of phase 1 ranking JSON printed to terminal; ranking saved to disk; hash committed in phase 2 header before any unblinding.
blinding_protocol.phase_2: Verifies phase 1 hash matches committed hash. Only then reads cancer-type and TtD columns. Runs pre-registered tests on unblinded labels.

primary.name: Secretory-class A-score case vs control
primary.robustness: Bootstrap 95% CI on d, 10000 resamples, random_seed=42
primary.decision_rule: Primary CONFIRMED if ALL THREE hold: (1) d > 0.3 in absolute value, (2) permutation p < 0.05, (3) bootstrap 95% CI excludes zero

secondary_exploratory.name: All 8 classes per patient, max-|dA| ranking
secondary_exploratory.test_stat: Per-class Cohen's d case vs control
secondary_exploratory.report_rule: Report all 8 Cohen's d values with 95% bootstrap CI. Flag any class with |d|>0.3 AND bootstrap lower CI exclusion as exploratory finding. Acknowledge multiple-comparison inflation.

tertiary_time_stratified.name: Sliding-window Cohen's d by time-to-diagnosis
tertiary_time_stratified.test_stat: Cohen's d computed on cases with TtD > cutoff vs full control group
tertiary_time_stratified.report_rule: Report d and bootstrap CI at each cutoff. Report whether effect size monotonically varies with cutoff. Pre-specified expectation based on VAL-046: signal present across the 2-5 year range at minimum.

negative_controls.age_split_null: Split controls (no cancer) into lower-age and upper-age halves. Compute Cohen's d on A-score. Expected: d near zero. If |d|>0.3 here, rules out primary finding as age-confounding artifact.
negative_controls.label_shuffle_null: Already captured by primary permutation test (resampled null distribution).

primary_panel.source: Xu 2020 JNCI Sister Study strongly-replicated 6-CpG breast cancer panel (PMID 30989176)
primary_panel.rationale: Pre-published as cancer-associated in the Sister Study, replicated at Bonferroni significance in Xu 2019. Using these CpGs is a legitimate pre-specification because they were selected by an independent group on a different cohort before VAL-047 existed.
primary_panel.caveat_acknowledged: Because these CpGs were originally selected for correlation with breast cancer outcome, the Cohen's d we observe using them to score the same cohort type may be inflated relative to a truly naive CpG selection. This caveat is acknowledged in the pre-registration and will be reported in phase 2.

fallback_panel.description: If primary CpGs have low coverage in GSE51057 (e.g. >2 of 6 missing), fall back to broader secretory-class atlas CpGs from Moss 2018 or Roadmap. Decision made at phase 1 based on coverage, not at phase 2 based on outcome.

statistical_parameters.test_sidedness: two-sided for primary, one-sided for time-stratified (cases should have LOWER variance, i.e. negative d in the variance channel per VAL-046 expectation)

interpretation_rules.if_primary_confirmed: Report as confirmed per-patient-level detection of blood-based pre-diagnostic signal with physics-derived floor. Generates VAL-047 result anchoring the paper's per-patient claim.
interpretation_rules.if_primary_null_or_weak: Report honestly. Do not reframe or cherry-pick secondary endpoints. Note that retrospective-individual-patient claim in the paper must be pulled, and paper leans on VAL-046 cohort-level findings plus VAL-006 aging extrapolation.
interpretation_rules.if_negative_control_violated: Primary result invalidated by age-confounding. Report and pull from paper.
interpretation_rules.general: All results reported with CI and p-value. No p-hacking. No post-hoc rule changes. Single analysis, single pass.

HEALTHY_BASELINES.json.source: G-003b MCMC posterior output, IAMPerformance internal

compute_environment.runtime_notes: Any subsequent re-run using identical random_seed should produce bit-identical results to phase1_ranking.json and phase2_results.json.

citations.title: Blood DNA Methylation and Breast Cancer: A Prospective Case-Cohort Analysis in the Sister Study
citations.role: Primary source for GSE51057 cohort and the 6-CpG panel

citations.title: Comprehensive human cell-type methylation atlas reveals origins of circulating cell-free DNA in health and disease
